maria.getz: FYI — Customer ACME sent back the security questionnaire. They specifically want: list of RBAC roles used for tenant isolation, sample audit log entries proving KMS envelope wrapping, and confirmation of key rotation policy. Can we assemble a short packet before the call tomorrow?
ajay.patel: I can put together the RBAC mapping + minimal playbook. For tenant isolation we have `tenant_reader`, `tenant_writer`, `infra_admin` (no cross-tenant perms). Do they want role definitions or just examples? :thinking_face:
sarah.lee: They asked for evidence they can attach to their audit. So examples of actual log lines + a note on retention/aggregation would be ideal. I can export 30d of example entries redacted.
ethan.kim: For KMS: we use envelope encryption with CloudKMS/HSM in Private deployments, key material never leaves HSM. We rotate CMKs annually by default and have asymmetric keys for signing. If they need rotation proof, we can provide rotation logs from KMS: `projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*/cryptoKeyVersions` events.
ajay.patel: Ok, assemble this structure: 1) RBAC matrix CSV, 2) Redacted audit log JSON lines (with request IDs), 3) KMS rotation timeline + sample API call responses. I'll draft.
maria.getz: Quick ask — customer wants the audit logs to show envelope-wrapping step. Is that in our standard logs or only in Private deployments?
ethan.kim: We log envelope metadata (key version id, wrapped key ID, operation=ENCRYPT/DECRYPT) in Private and Dedicated with KMS integration. Hosted teams have managed KMS and we emit an event but not full key IDs by default; we can produce a hardened export for enterprise under NDA.
sarah.lee: Draft of redacted log sample below (replace tenant IDs with T-REDACTED):
```
{"ts":"2024-04-04T18:02:11Z","service":"redwood-crypto","action":"ENVELOPE_WRAP","tenant":"T-REDACTED","key_version":"projects/xyz/locations/us/keyRings/ring1/cryptoKeys/keyA/cryptoKeyVersions/3","request_id":"req-9b7f"}
{"ts":"2024-04-04T18:02:11Z","service":"redwood-storage","action":"STORE_OBJECT","object":"obj-123","tenant":"T-REDACTED","envelope_id":"env-9b7f"}
```
ajay.patel: Nice. Add a short blurb: "We never log plaintext or unwrapped CEKs; logs contain key IDs and operation metadata only." Also include our log retention (90 days default for hosted, configurable for Dedicated/Private).
maria.getz: Perfect. For RBAC proof can you include a short audit trail showing role assignment change? Example below for IAM audit: `actor=infra-admin, action=grant_role, target=service-account, role=tenant_writer, ts=...`
ethan.kim: Will redact personal identifiers and include request IDs. Also adding pointer to our KMS rotation policy doc: https://internal.redwood/security/kms-rotation (send as internal link).
secbot: Auto-note: a security review call is scheduled with ACME on 2024-04-05 17:00 UTC. Meeting link sent.
sarah.lee: I'll assemble the packet and drop into the shared drive in `security/evidence/acme-2024-04-05` by EOD today. Anyone want to review before I deliver?
ajay.patel: I'll review RBAC & traces. Leaving inline comments in drive. :+1:
maria.getz: Thanks team — please keep responses concise. I will take the call and present. If ACME asks about cryptographic attestation, we can escalate to infra-crypto. :eyes:
